title: Nutty Crunchy Portuguese King Prawns Skillet
description: A hearty, high-protein Portuguese dish featuring king prawns, crunchy nuts, and a flavorful sauce, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe combines the richness of prawns with the crunch of nuts and the warmth of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the almonds from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the king prawns to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until pink and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the cooked almonds to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
